flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui: App.tsx (message-sent route commented out), EditTemplateForm.tsx (Preview/test commented out). Folder pages/epic37 (ComposeAction, PreviewTemplate) deleted. ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi: no ad-hoc test send or confirm endpoint
note: The story asks for three options on the preview screen: test send the first message to an officer-entered number/email, confirm sending, or go back to amend. The preview screen is not on main (see OCMS37.4), so none of the three options exists. Remaining trace: onTestMap/SendDataMap('TEST', ...) in EditTemplateForm.tsx:43,58 is commented out and refers to an Epic37Map that does not exist. The ComposeAction component (action buttons/modal) exists only in git history (commit 07aba128). The related options live in siblings OCMS37.6 (test send), 37.7 (back), 37.8 (send); the sheet marks 37.8 'Fully paid' although no ad-hoc send code exists on main (not judged in this story). No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. The three option buttons on the preview screen are not on main

steps.step: Preview offers a test send of the first message to an entered number or email
steps.detail: There is no test send option. The onTestMap and SendDataMap('TEST', type, data) references in EditTemplateForm.tsx:43,58 are commented out and Epic37Map is not on main. No ad-hoc endpoint in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi (grep adhoc/ad-hoc, compose, message-sent, enotification-send, scheduled send: zero hits in src; the only send-email/send-sms are in ManualReviewController.java:300 and :401, for furnish replies that require txnNo and noticeNo, not ad-hoc).

steps.step: Preview offers an option to confirm sending
steps.detail: There is no ad-hoc confirm-send button. The message-sent route is commented out (App.tsx:269) and no ad-hoc send endpoint exists. No ad-hoc endpoint in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi (grep adhoc/ad-hoc, compose, message-sent, enotification-send, scheduled send: zero hits in src; the only send-email/send-sms are in ManualReviewController.java:300 and :401, for furnish replies that require txnNo and noticeNo, not ad-hoc).

steps.step: Preview offers going back to amend messages or numbers
steps.detail: There is no preview screen or previous page (compose form) to return to. The existing Back buttons (e.g. EditTemplateForm.tsx) belong to the template form, not the ad-hoc flow.
